worldcombat.skill.xscissor.summary: Both scythes close together into one cut from either side of the body: the jaw sweeps a narrow band forward each tick, and anything caught in it is cut once. The closed form narrows the jaw and bites deeper but is slower; the open form spreads wider with a shorter wind-up and cooldown. Aim at an enemy, or just sweep a direction over empty air.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.description.0: When the jaw closes, each foe it sweeps takes %1$s contact damage; a target is settled only once per close.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.description.1: The blades open about %1$s degrees and close toward each other over about %2$s s, tips crossing the midline; each foe swept by the jaw is cut once, and something that steps sideways may slip out before it shuts.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.description.2: In the closed form the blades bite deeper: a foe that is cut takes %1$s extra damage.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.growth.0: From level %1$s each cut rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.growth.1: From level %1$s the closing reach extends to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.use.0: One cut as both blades close, on whatever the jaw holds
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.use.1: Take a row of foes standing side by side in front
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.use.2: Close sideways, to force movement or land the last hit
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.preference.sc: On (closed): the opening tightens to 86 degrees and each cut carries an extra bonus, at +1 wind-up tick and +4 cooldown ticks. Off (open): the opening widens to 128 degrees with a shorter wind-up and cooldown, at the cost of the bonus.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of cutting. Larger values open the close from further out.

On: with two or more enemies inside the forward jaw (in range, within half the jaw opening) it cuts first, treating the move as a way to trim a row. Off: it always prefers the current threat. Enemies behind it are not counted.
